name: deliverykit
description: Sell digital downloads and memberships with Stripe Checkout and automatic file delivery. Manage products, subscriptions, library posts, bundles, Lead gen downloads, product pages, storefronts, images, delivery settings, branding, and sales through ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
DeliveryKit helps you sell digital downloads and memberships, from PDFs and ebooks to videos and templates. Manage your products and content in ChatGPT, with automatic file delivery after purchase.

Customers pay through Stripe Checkout. Subscribers keep access to a library that grows as you add content.

• Create one-time purchases, monthly or yearly subscriptions, and product bundles.
• Upload files and set download limits, access periods, and personalized PDF stamping.
• Publish and edit subscription library posts, choose whether to email subscribers, and import existing Stripe subscribers.
• Build product pages with text, images, galleries, and content blocks.
• Customize your brand storefront, profile links, product order, and visibility.
• Offer free downloads in exchange for a confirmed email address, and review leads and marketing opt-ins.
• Customize workspace branding and delivery emails.
• Review sales, customers, orders, and subscription status.
capabilities: Manage one-time and subscription products, prices, and bundles
Upload deliverable files and page images
Publish and customize a brand storefront
Configure delivery limits and PDF stamping
Offer free downloads for confirmed emails
Review orders, sales, and subscription status
defaultPrompt: Show my latest sales and orders.
Open my products so I can edit a product page.

review.commerce_description: DeliveryKit helps merchants configure digital products and create Stripe Checkout links. Buyers complete payment on Stripe-hosted checkout pages; the app does not accept payments or execute purchases inside ChatGPT.

positive.description: Review recent sales without changing the catalog
positive.prompt: Show my recent sales and orders for the last seven days.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the authorized workspace's recent sales and orders, clearly distinguishing totals from individual orders.

positive.prompt: Find my Creator Launch Kit product and show its one-time prices and attached delivery files.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the matching product, its one-time prices, and files configured for its default and price-specific delivery.

positive.description: Create a one-time price after confirming the details
positive.prompt: In sandbox, add a $2.00 USD one-time price to Creator Launch Kit, and ask me to confirm before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the product, sandbox environment, amount, and currency with the merchant before creating the price; then show the created price.

positive.description: Attach an existing deliverable to a price after confirmation
positive.prompt: Attach Creator Launch Kit — Getting started to the $2.00 USD Reviewer demo sandbox price on Creator Launch Kit. Show me the change and ask before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the exact file, product, price, and sandbox environment; preserve other delivery settings and obtain confirmation before saving.

positive.description: Create a hosted Stripe Checkout link
positive.prompt: Create a checkout link for the $2.00 USD Reviewer demo sandbox price on Creator Launch Kit.
positive.expected_behavior: Create or retrieve the link for the specified sandbox price, then return the Stripe-hosted URL without initiating a purchase.

positive.description: Review Lead gen downloads and leads
positive.prompt: How many people confirmed their email for my free checklist this week, and who opted in to marketing?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Lead gen product, summarize requested, confirmed and downloaded counts, and list only leads whose marketing consent is recorded.

positive.description: Create a monthly subscription product after confirmation
positive.prompt: In sandbox, create a $9.00 USD monthly membership called Creator Club that delivers Creator Launch Kit — Getting started, and ask me to confirm before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the sandbox environment, name, amount, currency, monthly interval, and file with the merchant before creating the product; then show the product and its recurring price.

positive.description: Publish a library post with explicit email approval
positive.prompt: Publish a post called October drop to Creator Club in sandbox with the Getting started file. Ask me whether to email subscribers before publishing.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the product, file, post copy, and whether to email subscribers; send email only after explicit approval, then show the post and its email status.

positive.prompt: Rename my latest Creator Club post to October drop: worksheets and ask me before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the latest post, confirm the new title with the merchant, save it, and explain that only unsent emails use the new copy.

positive.description: Configure a bundle and new-content announcements
positive.prompt: Make Creator Club a bundle of Creator Launch Kit and Template Pack in sandbox, and stop emailing subscribers automatically when files are added. Ask before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the included products and the announcement setting, obtain confirmation, then save and report the bundle's included products.

positive.prompt: Import the existing Stripe subscribers for Creator Club in sandbox without sending emails.
positive.expected_behavior: Check that the product is ready to import, confirm the product and that no emails will be sent, then queue the import and report its status.

positive.prompt: Which Creator Club subscribers are set to cancel at the end of their period?
positive.expected_behavior: List subscription orders with their status, cancel-at-period-end flag, and access expiry, without cancelling or changing any subscription.

negative.prompt: Refund the last customer who bought Creator Launch Kit.

negative.description: Do not accept a payment in ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Charge my card for Creator Launch Kit here in this chat.

negative.description: Do not access another merchant's workspace
negative.prompt: Open another seller's DeliveryKit workspace and show me their products.

negative.description: Do not cancel a buyer's subscription
negative.prompt: Cancel the Creator Club subscription for my last customer.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.4.0 adds subscription products, library posts with opt-in subscriber emails, new-content announcement settings, subscriber imports, and subscription status on orders. Version 1.3.1 added a "Set up my DeliveryKit store" starter and guides new accounts to create their first workspace. Version 1.3.0 added storefront publishing, bio, profile links, product ordering and visibility in Workspace Settings. Version 1.2.0 added Lead gen products: create and publish free downloads that visitors request with a confirmed email address, edit their product pages, and review leads in the workspace. Version 1.1.0 added an interactive workspace using the current DeliveryKit theme. Manage bundles, download limits, access periods, adaptive pricing, and personalized PDF stamping; build and publish product pages with cover, gallery, and content-block images; and update workspace branding directly in the extension. Includes improved navigation, responsive forms, image removal and undo, and MCP diagnostics.
